change: Track evaluated Let values explicitly; binding frames apply lexical values after resolving ancestors and before own item. Let hides old For binding metadata; a new For hides same-name Let metadata.
regression: IR Let prefix shadows root prefix; compound key uses lexical value after model prefix changes and collection reorders; fresh/cached maps edit original item and preserve current model prefix.
limitations: Evaluated Let snapshots only; dynamic expression reevaluation against changed model remains unqualified.
Let-derived collection aliases not supported by stable parent resolution.
IR proof, not complete compiler/browser/AOT qualification.
